abstract: Fit more context or concurrent requests by quantizing the KV cache across vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, llama.cpp, Ollama, ExLlamaV3 and TensorFold. Covers FP8, NVFP4, int8 and q8_0/q4_0 with exact per-engine flags, defaults, hardware and constraints, KV size arithmetic, calibration, upstream accuracy evidence, and a mandatory A/B quality gate with the llm-evals skill including rollback.
